scope: Debug dataset-20261012-084638; host FP64, no ground truth. Device calibration unchanged.

conclusions.supported: Unmodelled gyro scale/axis effects strongly contribute to aggressive-motion prediction mismatch and visual constraint loss.
conclusions.not_established: Estimated intrinsic coefficients are not independent sensor calibration; a frozen correction does not generalize to another recording.
conclusions.integration: Midpoint-only propagation does not rescue this dataset.
conclusions.coverage: All main-record Schur runs output 885/885 poses. The independent recording consumes 829 frames and outputs the same 610 post-initialization poses in both variants, beginning at 10.975768s.
conclusions.remaining: Corrected SchurVINS still loses many visual constraints and reaches >4m displacement versus <1m in the earlier OpenVINS online reference. Closure alone is not accuracy.
